name: Law firm size, solos and receipts, by state: Census SUSB 2022, Nonemployer Statistics 2024 and Economic Census 2022
description: How big U.S. law firms are and what they take in, for the US, every state and DC, from three Census Bureau sources. Employer law firms (NAICS 541110, offices of lawyers) by number of employees (fewer than 5, 5 to 9, 10 to 19, 20 to 99, 100 to 499, 500 or more) with their employees, payroll and receipts, from the Statistics of U.S. Businesses (SUSB) 2022. Businesses with no employees (mostly sole practitioners) and their receipts, by legal form, from Nonemployer Statistics 2024, which publishes legal services (NAICS 5411) as one group. Firm counts, receipts, the share of receipts held by the largest firms and firms by receipts size from the Economic Census 2022. One record per jurisdiction and class. Every size-class row the Census Bureau publishes adds up to its total row, and every figure is the Bureau's own, never estimated.
citeAs: Probative Growth. (2026). Law firm size, solos and receipts, by state: Census SUSB 2022, Nonemployer Statistics 2024 and Economic Census 2022 (Version 2.0.0) [Data set]. Zenodo. https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23898123
keywords: law firms by number of employees

distribution.name: law-firm-economy.csv
distribution.description: Every record, one row each (RFC 4180, UTF-8). Columns are described in README.txt.

distribution.name: law-firm-economy.json
distribution.description: Every record with its full sources, under a meta envelope (credit line, DOI, license).

distribution.name: law-firm-economy-values.csv
distribution.description: The columns listed in README.txt as being in law-firm-economy-values.csv, one row per id, column and value; join it to law-firm-economy.csv on id.

recordSet.name: law-firm-economy
recordSet.description: The records of Law firm size, solos and receipts, by state: Census SUSB 2022, Nonemployer Statistics 2024 and Economic Census 2022, one per CSV row.

field.name: jurisdiction
field.description: US, a two-letter state code or DC

field.name: sizeClass
field.description: all, lt5, 5-9, 10-19, 20-99, 100-499 or 500+ (employees in the firm, SUSB); nonemployer (no employees, NES); econ-census (Economic Census 2022); and, for the US only, nes-<receipts band>, ec-top4/8/20/50 and ec-rcpt-<receipts band>

field.name: survey
field.description: SUSB (Statistics of U.S. Businesses 2022), NES (Nonemployer Statistics 2024) or EC (Economic Census 2022)

field.name: status
field.description: P primary source, S secondary source

field.name: value
field.description: Firms in the class (businesses for nonemployer); for ec-top records, the share of all law-firm receipts in percent

field.name: firms
field.description: Employer law firms (SUSB, EC) or nonemployer businesses (NES). A firm is counted once in each state where it has an office

field.name: text
field.description: The record in one plain-English sentence

field.name: effectiveFrom
field.description: When the fact took effect (YYYY-MM-DD), if known

field.name: effectiveTo
field.description: When it stopped applying; empty while current

field.name: lastChecked
field.description: The day it was last confirmed (YYYY-MM-DD)

field.name: sourceUrls
field.description: Source URLs, in the same order

field.name: confidence
field.description: high, medium or low: computed from status, a second check, age against the refresh cadence and sampling error (rule: /data/#confidence)

field.name: confidenceBasis
field.description: The reasons for the confidence level, in a short phrase
